verdict.rationale: The only evidence that WezTerm acts on links is a community comment listing 'hyperlinks' as a reason to choose it over Alacritty. Quick Select is documented for keyboard selection of commonly copied patterns, but it only copies the match to the clipboard and is not shown to open URLs or paths. missing for 10: first-party docs on clicking URLs to open them, opening file paths from output, keyboard-driven open (not just copy), and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open URLs and file paths from output by clicking them or selecting them from the keyboard

citations.quote: Reasons given over Alacritty: ligatures, copy mode, hyperlinks, native scrollback
Quick Select mode allows you to quickly highlight text that matches commonly copied patterns, select a match by typing a one-or-two character prefix and copy it to the clipboard.
